# Suppix AI UG · WorkPass

> Suppix AI UG (also: Suppix, Suppix AI, SUPPIX AI) builds WorkPass – a digital time-tracking and access platform for construction, industry and teams in Berlin, Germany and Europe.

- Official site: https://suppixai.com
- Product login: https://suppix-ai-workpass.com

- About: https://suppixai.com/ueber-uns.html
- Time tracking Berlin: https://suppixai.com/zeiterfassung-berlin.html
- Demo: https://suppixai.com/demo.html
- Imprint: https://suppixai.com/impressum.html

## Product
WorkPass combines identity, gate/access (QR, NFC, GPS), live attendance (Live Map), reports and DATEV handoff. Physical cards work without smartphones.

## Languages
German (primary), English, Arabic, Polish.
